die Strecke, die der Zug befahrt
die Strecke, das der Zug befahrt
die Strecke, welche der Zug befahrt

questions.explanation: Feminine accusative relative pronoun is die. Dative, neuter, and plural forms misassign.

questions.learningObjective: Negate a noun phrase in nominative case
questions.stem: The planner states no delay was announced.
questions.explanation: Feminine nominative singular uses keine. Masculine and genitive forms misassign gender and case.

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.learningObjective: Apply the correct ending after a quantity expression
questions.stem: Explain why viele freie Plaetze uses the strong plural ending after viele.

answer.exemplar: Viele is not a full article, so the adjective takes strong endings, yielding viele freie Plaetze in nominative plural.

questions.explanation: Quantity expressions like viele do not carry full case marking, so strong endings apply. Weak endings would be wrong here.

questions.learningObjective: Choose the correct adjective in a compound transit phrase

stimulus.body: The planner describes a train that runs without stopping.

questions.stem: Which adjective fits the transit description?
questions.explanation: Masculine nominative singular after an indefinite article takes mixed ending -er. Neuter and weak endings misassign.
